description.en: The ID of the DTS migration, synchronization, or change tracking task.

description.zh:
任务DU上限。

> 最小取值为**1**。
description.en:
The DU upper limit of the task.

> The minimum value is **1**.

title.en: Modify DU upper limit of a task

descriptions.zh:
- 专属集群的DTS实例需要支持升降配，通过改变任务运行时占用的资源，动态调整当前集群可调度的任务数，实现对集群总DU数量的扣减和释放。
- 修改作业DU上限前，需要确保资源余量足够。
descriptions.en:
- DTS instances in a dedicated cluster must support specification changes. By changing the resources consumed by a task at runtime, you can dynamically adjust the number of schedulable tasks in the current cluster, thereby deducting or releasing the total number of DUs in the cluster.
- Before modifying the DU upper limit of a task, ensure that sufficient resources are available.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dts modify-dts-job-du-limit --dts-job-id dtsxxx --du-limit 1 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-group-id rg-acfmzawhxxc0000 --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
